normalization_plan.reason: The sender address parameter is only meaningful inside _transfer, where it drives the balance debit and flag checks.
The recipient address parameter is only used by _transfer for balance credit and flag assignment.
The amount parameter exists solely to update balances and evaluate the harry threshold inside _transfer.
The spender parameter only identifies the address whose flags TimeTime overwrites.
The val parameter is a transient boolean only used to write flag mappings in TimeTime.
The newOwner parameter only exists to be passed into the ownership transfer path.
Local screen holds the pseudo-random result produced and returned by randomly().
Local tok temporarily holds the allowance value that _approve persists.
Local tempval is a throwaway copy of the supply read by Glasses.
The account parameter only designates the balance credited by _mint.
